# Khadija Zaman

> Marketing Manager at Wellows specializing in SEO and AI-search visibility (GEO/AEO). I help brands get found on Google and cited inside AI answer engines — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews — using semantic SEO, content strategy, and marketing automation run as one system.

Khadija Zaman is an SEO and AI-search specialist based in Karachi, Pakistan, working with clients worldwide. Her work grew Google Search Console impressions from 680K to 3.78M and increased LLM referral traffic 22× in 12 months, entirely through organic search with zero paid spend. She builds free public tools grounded in Google patent research, used by 1,647 practitioners across the UK, US, and EU.

This site covers her case studies, free SEO/AEO tools, and writing on how modern search visibility works across both traditional search engines and AI answer engines.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://khadijazaman.com/): Overview of Khadija's work in SEO and AI-search visibility, with verified results and proof.
- [About](https://khadijazaman.com/about/): Background, career history, credentials, and specialisms in semantic SEO and AI search.
- [Work & Case Studies](https://khadijazaman.com/work/): Detailed case studies with GSC/GA4-verified metrics across AEO/LLM visibility, SEO, content, and automation.
- [Contact](https://khadijazaman.com/contact/): How to hire Khadija for a full-time role or specialist SEO / AI-search strategy.

## Free tools
- [Citeability Checker](https://khadijazaman.com/tools/citeability-checker/): Scores how likely a page is to be cited by AI answer engines and shows what to fix.
- [SERP Preview](https://khadijazaman.com/tools/serp-preview/): Pixel-accurate preview of how a title and description render in Google search results.
- [Query Fan-Out Explorer](https://khadijazaman.com/tools/query-fan-out/): Expands a seed query into the sub-questions AI engines generate when answering, based on Google's query fan-out patent.
- [Schema Generator](https://khadijazaman.com/tools/schema-generator/): Generates valid JSON-LD structured data to help search and answer engines understand a page.

## Writing
- [I Built a Test Designed to Break My Own Study. Two Findings Didn't Survive.](https://khadijazaman.com/blog/breaking-my-own-study/): How I rebuilt my cross-engine AI citation study from scratch, ran it against a permutation null, and retracted two headline findings that didn't hold up.
- [Topic Cluster Architecture That Actually Scales Organic Traffic](https://khadijazaman.com/blog/topic-cluster-architecture/): Publishing more rarely fixes a plateau — fragmented architecture does. How to structure pillars, clusters, and internal links so authority concentrates.
- [How to Get Your Brand Cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity](https://khadijazaman.com/blog/get-cited-by-ai-search/): Ranking #1 in Google no longer guarantees you appear in an AI answer — the systems judge content differently. A checklist to make pages retrieval-ready.
- [SEO vs AEO vs GEO: What Each One Actually Means, and How to Sequence Them](https://khadijazaman.com/blog/geo-aeo-vs-seo/): SEO, AEO, and GEO are layers, not rivals. A working definition of each, where they genuinely diverge, and the order to build them so the work compounds.
